findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.name: Undersized functional text
findings.description: Interactive and content-bearing UI text (links, buttons, nav items, labels, table cells, meta rows, timecodes) below 11px is a legibility failure, not a style choice. WCAG sets no absolute pixel floor, but functional text under 11px is a defensible quality bar: it fails on high-DPI and small viewports and it degrades tap and read targets. The 11px floor holds even inside a footer; only non-interactive legal smallprint gets the softer 10px floor. Being ON the DESIGN.md size ramp does not exempt a value here: adding 8px to the ramp launders the token but not the legibility problem, and that is exactly the escape hatch this rule closes. Exempts sup/sub, visually-hidden (sr-only) text, and code/terminal contexts. Decorative letterspaced micro-labels are still functional and stay in scope.

The 11px floor holds even inside a footer; only non-interactive legal smallprint gets the softer 10px floor. Being ON the DESIGN.md size ramp does not exempt a value here: adding 8px to the ramp launders the token but not the legibility problem, and that is exactly the escape hatch this rule closes. Exempts sup/sub, visually-hidden (sr-only) text, and code/terminal contexts. Decorative letterspaced micro-labels are still functional and stay in scope.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.name: Overused font
findings.description: Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.

findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.name: Overused font
findings.description: Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.

findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

WCAG sets no absolute pixel floor, but functional text under 11px is a defensible quality bar: it fails on high-DPI and small viewports and it degrades tap and read targets. The 11px floor holds even inside a footer; only non-interactive legal smallprint gets the softer 10px floor. Being ON the DESIGN.md size ramp does not exempt a value here: adding 8px to the ramp launders the token but not the legibility problem, and that is exactly the escape hatch this rule closes. Exempts sup/sub, visually-hidden (sr-only) text, and code/terminal contexts. Decorative letterspaced micro-labels are still functional and stay in scope.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.name: Overused font
findings.description: Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.

findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.name: Overused font
findings.description: Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.

findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.detail: span "undersized functional te" is 100% covered by an opaque element (button.icon-tile)
findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.name: Undersized functional text
findings.description: Interactive and content-bearing UI text (links, buttons, nav items, labels, table cells, meta rows, timecodes) below 11px is a legibility failure, not a style choice. WCAG sets no absolute pixel floor, but functional text under 11px is a defensible quality bar: it fails on high-DPI and small viewports and it degrades tap and read targets. The 11px floor holds even inside a footer; only non-interactive legal smallprint gets the softer 10px floor. Being ON the DESIGN.md size ramp does not exempt a value here: adding 8px to the ramp launders the token but not the legibility problem, and that is exactly the escape hatch this rule closes. Exempts sup/sub, visually-hidden (sr-only) text, and code/terminal contexts. Decorative letterspaced micro-labels are still functional and stay in scope.

The 11px floor holds even inside a footer; only non-interactive legal smallprint gets the softer 10px floor. Being ON the DESIGN.md size ramp does not exempt a value here: adding 8px to the ramp launders the token but not the legibility problem, and that is exactly the escape hatch this rule closes. Exempts sup/sub, visually-hidden (sr-only) text, and code/terminal contexts. Decorative letterspaced micro-labels are still functional and stay in scope.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.name: Overused font
findings.description: Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.

findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Undersized functional text
findings.description: Interactive and content-bearing UI text (links, buttons, nav items, labels, table cells, meta rows, timecodes) below 11px is a legibility failure, not a style choice. WCAG sets no absolute pixel floor, but functional text under 11px is a defensible quality bar: it fails on high-DPI and small viewports and it degrades tap and read targets. The 11px floor holds even inside a footer; only non-interactive legal smallprint gets the softer 10px floor. Being ON the DESIGN.md size ramp does not exempt a value here: adding 8px to the ramp launders the token but not the legibility problem, and that is exactly the escape hatch this rule closes. Exempts sup/sub, visually-hidden (sr-only) text, and code/terminal contexts. Decorative letterspaced micro-labels are still functional and stay in scope.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.name: Overused font
findings.description: Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.

findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Undersized functional text
findings.description: Interactive and content-bearing UI text (links, buttons, nav items, labels, table cells, meta rows, timecodes) below 11px is a legibility failure, not a style choice. WCAG sets no absolute pixel floor, but functional text under 11px is a defensible quality bar: it fails on high-DPI and small viewports and it degrades tap and read targets. The 11px floor holds even inside a footer; only non-interactive legal smallprint gets the softer 10px floor. Being ON the DESIGN.md size ramp does not exempt a value here: adding 8px to the ramp launders the token but not the legibility problem, and that is exactly the escape hatch this rule closes. Exempts sup/sub, visually-hidden (sr-only) text, and code/terminal contexts. Decorative letterspaced micro-labels are still functional and stay in scope.

WCAG sets no absolute pixel floor, but functional text under 11px is a defensible quality bar: it fails on high-DPI and small viewports and it degrades tap and read targets. The 11px floor holds even inside a footer; only non-interactive legal smallprint gets the softer 10px floor. Being ON the DESIGN.md size ramp does not exempt a value here: adding 8px to the ramp launders the token but not the legibility problem, and that is exactly the escape hatch this rule closes. Exempts sup/sub, visually-hidden (sr-only) text, and code/terminal contexts. Decorative letterspaced micro-labels are still functional and stay in scope.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.

findings.name: Line length too long
findings.description: Text lines wider than ~80 characters are hard to read. The eye loses its place tracking back to the start of the next line. Add a max-width (65ch to 75ch) to text containers.

findings.name: Overused font
findings.description: Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.

findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
findings.description: Text is painted under an opaque element or a second text run, so part of it cannot be read. A decorative box, a stacked layer, or an inline element with leaked padding lands on the words instead of beside them. Give overlapping layers room, or move the text out from under the layer above it.

findings.name: Undersized functional text
findings.description: Interactive and content-bearing UI text (links, buttons, nav items, labels, table cells, meta rows, timecodes) below 11px is a legibility failure, not a style choice. WCAG sets no absolute pixel floor, but functional text under 11px is a defensible quality bar: it fails on high-DPI and small viewports and it degrades tap and read targets. The 11px floor holds even inside a footer; only non-interactive legal smallprint gets the softer 10px floor. Being ON the DESIGN.md size ramp does not exempt a value here: adding 8px to the ramp launders the token but not the legibility problem, and that is exactly the escape hatch this rule closes. Exempts sup/sub, visually-hidden (sr-only) text, and code/terminal contexts. Decorative letterspaced micro-labels are still functional and stay in scope.

findings.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
findings.description: A background image under a near-opaque gradient wash, or a raster on an element at near-zero opacity, never reaches the screen: the page shows the wash, and the produced texture or photo ships as a compliance token. Let the material show (a tint under 0.9 alpha, a blend mode, an opacity you can see) or remove the file.
